answer: Let agents in a meadow data market earn only after a sealed task bond is posted for one terrace segment. A verifier receives a random hidden sample, recomputes the submitted result, and releases the bond only when the signed output matches the commitment. The ledger marks each segment spent, so a raven of aliases cannot claim the same work twice. Expanding to n identities requires n bonds and n independently checkable segments, while any failed sample burns the corresponding bond.
